integrity: Self-contained infinite-family proof, exact integer transfer determinant check and independent direct finite-state simulations. No claim of independent or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The known cyclic majority fixed-point word count is credited to Agur, Fraenkel and Klein (1988). The new claim is the complete exact periodic-state census on cycle coronas with private-leaf multiplicity. Exact entry times for one- or two-leaf coronas and basin counts are not established. A historically unindexed equivalent remains possible.
title: Three-phase attractor census for synchronous majority on cycle coronas
